body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.45 (naive base rate 0.5) that: the GNPA % (bank's headline definition, advances incl. IBPC) at 31-Mar-2027 as first reported is <= 5.00% (Sep-2026: 5.96%). Our reasoning: Gross additions ~Rs 200-240 cr/qtr vs upgrades+recoveries ~65 and write-offs ~60-100; Q4 write-offs and an ARC sale are habitual (FY26 Q4 ARC Rs 624 cr), so <= 5% needs ~Rs 140 cr net reduction plus growth: close to even. Naive base: Direction-of-trend coin [EST 0.5]: GNPA % fell in 5 of the last 6 quarters but by write-offs/ARC sales. Resolution: YES if the GNPA % (bank's headline definition, advances incl. IBPC) at 31-Mar-2027 as first reported is <= 5.00% (Sep-2026: 5.96%). Source: NSE integrated-filing XBRL (PercentageOfGrossNpa) / press release Q4 FY27. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
